target.title: fix(discord): oversized uploads can exhaust memory before failing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord sends with very large multipart payloads could read each attachment Blob into memory and then concatenate the whole request body before failing, leaving oversized uploads able to exhaust process memory instead of failing at a bounded request size.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Discord REST client now applies a multipart aggregate body limit while building `FormData` requests. It checks string fields and Blob sizes before allocating their buffers, preserves successful multipart serialization, and sizes dedicated Discord REST multipart bodies from the existing `mediaMaxMb` payload limit plus bounded multipart overhead.

This does not change Discord response body limits, JSON/raw request bodies, public config shape, or proxy behavior.

## User Impact

Oversized Discord uploads now fail before the REST request is sent or a large Blob is read into memory. Normal uploads continue to serialize as multipart/form-data, and installations that configure `channels.discord.mediaMaxMb` keep that configured value as the media payload limit instead of losing capacity to multipart headers/boundaries.

## Evidence

- Refreshed `origin/main` before submission prep: `extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.ts` still used `Buffer.from(await value.arrayBuffer())` and `Buffer.concat(chunks)`; no same-problem open PR was found for `multipartBodyMaxBytes`, `Discord REST multipart body exceeds`, or bounded Discord multipart REST uploads.
- Runtime behavior proof with the real Discord REST multipart builder and a local HTTP server:

  ```text
  smallContentType=multipart/form-data; boundary=----openclaw-discord-144a8dc60cba98c28c65416d
  smallBodyBytes=366
  smallResult={"id":"ok"}
  oversizedError=Discord REST multipart body exceeds 256 bytes
  oversizedFetchCalls=0
  oversizedArrayBufferCalls=0
  ```

- Live Discord gateway proof with a real bot token, kept out of files and logs: OpenClaw gateway loaded the Discord plugin, then a `send` RPC with a base64 file buffer reached Discord as message `1524828475918385293` in channel `1518783426218430484` with attachment `openclaw-gateway-discord-multipart-proof.txt` through this path:

  ```text
  gateway send RPC
  hydrate base64 buffer attachment
  outbound discord adapter sendMedia
  sendDiscordMedia
  Discord REST multipart upload
  ```

- Focused Discord multipart tests:

  ```text
  pnpm -C "$TASK_WORKTREE" exec vitest run extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.test.ts extensions/discord/src/client.test.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts

   Test Files  3 passed (3)
        Tests  100 passed (100)
  ```

- Formatting:

  ```text
  pnpm -C "$TASK_WORKTREE" exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.ts extensions/discord/src/client.ts extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.test.ts extensions/discord/src/client.test.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts

  All matched files use the correct format.

  ```

- Lint: `pnpm -C "$TASK_WORKTREE" exec node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.ts extensions/discord/src/client.ts extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts extensions/discord/src/internal/rest.test.ts extensions/discord/src/client.test.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts` passed with exit code 0.
